mapper.insert: insert into score (id, user_id, course_id, score) values (#{scoreId}, #{studentId}, #{courseId}, null)
mapper.select: select s.id, s.score, c.course_no, c.course_name from score s left join course c on s.course_id = c.id where s.user_id = #{studentId}

select s.id as score_id,s.score,u.name as student_name,u.user_no as student_no,c.major,c.class_no from score s left join user u on s.user_id = u.id left join class c on u.class_id = c.id where s.course_id = #{courseId}
